component.name: LivePlayer
component.script:
sub init() m.video = m.top.findNode("video") m.loading = m.top.findNode("loading") m.loadingLbl = m.top.findNode("loadingLbl") m.errorLbl = m.top.findNode("errorLbl") m.npChannel = m.top.findNode("npChannel") m.npTitle = m.top.findNode("npTitle") m.npMeta = m.top.findNode("npMeta") m.nowPlaying = m.top.findNode("nowPlaying") m.npFade = m.top.findNode("npFade") m.video.observeField("state", "onVideoState") end sub
sub onChannelChange() ch = m.top.channel if ch = invalid or ch.id = invalid then return m.errorLbl.visible = false m.loadingLbl.text = "Tuning in to " + ch.name + "…" m.loading.visible = true m.nowPlaying.opacity = 0 m.resolver = CreateObject("roSGNode", "StreamResolver") m.resolver.apiBase = m.top.apiBase m.resolver.channelId = ch.id m.resolver.observeField("result", "onStreamResolved") m.resolver.observeField("error", "onStreamError") m.resolver.control = "RUN" end sub
sub onStreamResolved() r = m.resolver.result if r = invalid or r.stream_url = invalid then return ch = m.top.channel m.npChannel.text = UCase(ch.name) m.npTitle.text = r.title if r.duration <> invalid and r.duration > 0 m.npMeta.text = "Now playing · " + fmtDur(r.duration) else m.npMeta.text = "Now playing" end if m.npFade.control = "start"
ci = CreateObject("roSGNode", "ContentNode") ci.url = r.stream_url ci.streamFormat = pickFormat(r.format) ci.title = r.title m.video.content = ci m.video.control = "play" end sub
function pickFormat(fmt as dynamic) as string if fmt = invalid then return "mp4" f = LCase(fmt) if f = "hls" then return "hls" if f = "dash" then return "dash" return "mp4" end function
function fmtDur(secs as integer) as string m = Int(secs / 60) s = secs - m * 60 ss = s.ToStr() if Len(ss) < 2 then ss = "0" + ss return m.ToStr() + ":" + ss end function
sub onStreamError() m.loading.visible = false m.errorLbl.text = m.resolver.error m.errorLbl.visible = true end sub
sub onVideoState() state = m.video.state if state = "playing" m.loading.visible = false else if state = "error" m.errorLbl.text = "Playback error — advancing" m.errorLbl.visible = true m.loading.visible = false onChannelChange() else if state = "finished" ' Auto-advance to the next scheduled slot. onChannelChange() end if end sub
function onKeyEvent(key as String, press as Boolean) as Boolean if not press then return false if key = "back" m.video.control = "stop" m.top.closed = true return true end if if key = "OK" or key = "play" if m.video.state = "playing" m.video.control = "pause" else m.video.control = "resume" end if return true end if return false end function
